## Claims

- Aarhus University Hospital found that many patients not meeting indicator 1 had sufficient diagnostic workup at other hospitals, and some patients declined colonoscopy [^src1] ([[aarhus-university-hospital|Aarhus University Hospital]])
- Regionshospitalet Gødstrup reviewed 7 cases of re-operation, finding surgical complications in 3 cases and no signs of surgical complications in 4 cases [^src1] ([[goedstrup-hospital|Gødstrup Hospital]])
